figures.caption: Direct binding measurements of the interaction between peptidomimetics 4, 9, 16, and 18 and HA (H1N1 hemagglutinin, Cat No.: Z03181, GenScript, NE). MST binding affinity assays were carried out as described in the Materials and Methods section (Section 3). The single dose–response curves for the binding of the peptidomimetics 4, 9, 16, and 18 to HA are depicted; Fnorm, normalized fluorescence. The experiments were repeated independently three times. The reported KD is the mean SD of three independent experiments.
figures.label: Figure 2

figures.caption: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis. Sensorgrams to evaluate the binding affinity between HA (H1N1 hemagglutinin, Cat No. Z03181, GenScript, NE) and peptidomimetics 4, 9, 16, and 18. Each compound was injected at six different concentrations (0.32, 0.63, 1.25, 2.5, 5, and 10 µM). The ratio between the kinetic dissociation (koff) and association (kon) constants was used to determine the equilibrium dissociation constants (KD).
figures.label: Figure 3

figures.caption: (Panels (A,C) Docked poses of peptoids 16 and 18 represented as sticks (orange and purple C atoms, respectively) in the RBS of A/Parma/24/09 H1N1 (deep-cyan cartoon). Just the HA residues that interact with the ligands are shown as lines for clarity’s sake. H-bonds are represented as yellow dashed lines. (Panels (B,D)) Corresponding 2D ligand interaction diagrams; in these diagrams, residues close to the ligand are colored according to their properties (orange, negatively charged; blue, positively charged; green, hydrophobic; cyan, polar); H-bonds are shown as magenta arrows; and a gray shadow encircles atoms that are exposed to the solvent.
